classification_correction: 2026-10-11: These six metrics require human semantic judgments; they are not deterministic mechanical evaluation. Agreed definitions are preserved.
aggregation: Within each scope, average eligible per-case ratios equally; pooled ratios secondary; binary response error rates use one equal vote per valid response.
failure_policy: Generation failures and empty responses fail whole-case/pair success, but are missing for six content metrics. Disclose planned, valid, failed, missing, pending and eligible counts.
zero_denominator: N/A, never automatically perfect or zero
unsupported_and_contradiction_overlap: Record all applicable flags; never add rates together.
no_supported_claims_due_to_proper_absten: Personal fact accuracy N/A; abstention and whole success remain applicable.
pair_aggregation: Each type has 5 planned pairs; both sides must pass; shared original reused; no independent sample claim.
semantic_judgment: Human checks proposition/evidence, negation, hypotheses, quotations and final retraction; no substring-based semantic verdict claimed.
pending_semantic_labels: Do not treat pending labels as correct, no-error or failure; keep metrics provisional and show pending counts.
scope: Six fact metrics initially mapped to baseline G01-G05 and the separate expansion. Other 15 baseline questions retain their human evaluation; no single factual gold invented for free dialogue.
existing_baseline: Retrospective oracle annotations; original human scores unchanged; no claim of blind/prospective grading for already-known outputs.
new_expansion: 20 confirmed prompts; blind model identity in first-round grading
generation_conditions: Preserve existing system prompt, greedy policy, 160-token main cap, and separate 320-token supplement policy; runner not modified.
whole_success: All known slots correct, unknown slots explicitly abstained, no unsupported/contradictory final claims or unresolved competing claims; misleading premise corrected/marked unverifiable; valid nonempty generation.
language_and_quality: Factual whole-success does not certify Korean fluency or usefulness; four human categories remain separate.
